chapter: Billie Holiday and the band's singers
title: Billie Holiday joins Basie; the January 1937 record date
summary: Jones explains why the band wanted a woman singer, and gives January 25, 1937 for the first Teddy Wilson date with Billie Holiday and the Basie men.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I'd just like to get to this. When was the marriage of the Basie band and Billie Holiday encountered? Let's get into Billie because we're up to about 1946, is that it? We're up to 1936 now. 1936 is when the Basie band came to New York? Is that the first time you ran into Billie Holiday?
JONES: Yes. H: Tell us about that.

I run into Billie - now we got Jimmie Rushing, so now we're tired of going out on the road with a bunch of men, so we got to have a vocalist. A girl, got to have some woman there, you know what I mean, because if we got a woman in the group at least we can get some rooming houses, if we got a woman in the group, you know. So we take Billie.
She was the first girl vocalist with your band?

Of course. We went to Auburn, New York, and here come this girl. But Lester had known her work. But she was there, a band girl, you know, and vocalist. We just going along, we don't know what's happening, we just going on.
What year was this?
1937. You remember that I have the record thing that we had done with her on the recording date when we was at the Roseland Ballroom when we was coming out in
JONES 183
January, and Benny Goodman -
The discography speaks for itself.
That's right. This is something else, you know.
You can tell us in your own words because for the record's sake we can look up the discography. did with her? That's a matter of record... What was the first date you/
With Billie?
With Basie's band.
The first date that we did with Miss Billie Holiday, when I walked into the studio, the first date that I can remember, is -
Well I tell you, we'll just cut the tape off here and you can check it out -
I have it - January 25th, 1937. Buck Clayton, Benny Goodman, Lester Young, Teddy Wilson, Freddie Greene, Walter Page, myself, and Miss Billie Holiday.
What happened to Basie?
Basie wasn't supposed to be on the date, because remember Teddy was with Benny Goodman. This is Teddy Wilson and his orchestra.
This was a marriage of the Basie group and Billie Holiday, using the piano of Teddy Wilson.
Right. Now later -
